structured.answer: Hold it at Pasgot and buy the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) tracking fund: the page says that ends at 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. The broker you pick matters about five times more than the fund (a swing of up to 22,985 ₪ against up to 4,492 ₪), but I'd check Pasgot's price list and the assumed return before moving anything.
